likely.en: For the majority of you listening, you are likely most familiar with “linear time”.
likely.zh: 这就是时间沿直线流逝的观点。

likely.en: The current consensus is that George III is likely to have had bipolar disorder.
likely.zh: 目前的共识是，George III 很可能患有双相情感障碍。

likely.en: But in a post-truth environment, voters are more likely to be influenced by emotion.
likely.zh: 但在后真相环境中，选民更容易受情绪影响。

likely.en: Their algorithms are designed to show users the posts most likely to attract their attention.
likely.zh: 它们的算法旨在向用户展示最能吸引他们注意力的帖子。

likely.en: If you have heard the word “cartel” before, it’s most likely in a negative sense.
likely.zh: 如果你以前听过“卡特尔”这个词，它很可能是在负面意义上被提及的。

limited.en: In a surveillance society, monitoring is not limited to one place or one moment.
limited.zh: 在一个监控社会中，监视并不局限于一个地方或一个时刻。

limited.en: With very limited land and very limited resources, cooperation across the island was essential.
limited.zh: 在土地和资源都非常有限的情况下，全岛的合作至关重要。

limited.en: With very limited land and very limited resources, cooperation across the island was essential.
limited.zh: 在土地和资源都非常有限的情况下，全岛的合作至关重要。

limited.en: Darwin realized that in nature, animals and plants were also competing for limited resources.
limited.zh: Darwin意识到，在大自然中，动植物同样在为有限的资源进行竞争。

limited.en: For example, they limited the use of Polish language in schools and some government institutions.
limited.zh: 例如，他们限制了波兰语在学校和一些政府机构中的使用。

limit.en: But first, our quiz question. World leaders promised in 2015 to limit global temperature rises.
limit.zh: 但首先，是我们的问答环节。世界领导人在 2015 年承诺限制全球气温上升。

limit.en: And the court would interpret the laws. Each branch of government could limit each other.
limit.zh: 法院解释法律。政府的每个分支都可以互相制衡。

limit.en: In fact, until May of 2025, there were no generational limits for jus sanguinis citizenship.
limit.zh: 事实上，直到2025年5月，基于血统原则（jus sanguinis）的公民身份在世代上没有任何限制。

limit.en: Countries that once focused on attracting people are now focused on control, limits, and conditions.
limit.zh: 那些曾经致力于吸引人才的国家，现在把重点转向了控制、限制和条件。

limit.en: I asked how much world leaders agreed to limit global temperature rises to.
limit.zh: 我问的是世界领导人同意将全球气温上升限制在多少以内。

link.en: In 1901, there was an outbreak of a disease linked to malnutrition and vitamin deficiency.
link.zh: 1901 年，爆发了一种与营养不良和维生素缺乏有关的疾病。

link.en: Professors, airline executives, computer store owners, there seemed to be nothing linking them.
link.zh: 教授、航空公司高管、电脑店老板，他们之间似乎没有任何联系。

link.en: His job was a lot like Mike Garner's. He's the same link in the chain.
link.zh: 他的工作和 Mike Garner 的很像。他们在链条上的位置是一样的。

link.en: But the flavours and the noodles themselves maintain a link to the past.
link.zh: 但风味和面条本身依然保持着与过去的联系。

link.en: Rail connections linked Berlin to other German and European cities as well.
link.zh: 铁路连接也将柏林与其他德国和欧洲城市连接起来。

likelihood.en: Darren said that if a storm moves more slowly, there will be more likelihood of flooding.
likelihood.zh: Darren说，如果风暴移动更慢，发生洪水的可能性就会更大。

likelihood.en: The feasibility of something is the likelihood that it can be achieved.
likelihood.zh: 某事的可行性（feasibility）是可以实现的可能性。

likelihood.en: Likelihood is the noun that we use to say how probable, or how likely something is to happen.
likelihood.zh: 可能性（likelihood）是我们用来表示某事有多大可能发生的名词。

likelihood.en: Higher scores on the Mesquite predict less likelihood of drug or alcohol use, less likelihood of delinquent behavior.
likelihood.zh: MSCEIT 得分越高，使用毒品或酒精的可能性就越低，做出不良行为的可能性也越低。

likelihood.en: Higher scores on the Mesquite predict less likelihood of drug or alcohol use, less likelihood of delinquent behavior.
likelihood.zh: MSCEIT 得分越高，使用毒品或酒精的可能性就越低，做出不良行为的可能性也越低。

liquid.en: Liquid clay technology is still new, and costing around 2,000 dollars an acre, it’s not cheap.
liquid.zh: 液态粘土技术仍然很新，每英亩成本约为2000美元，并不便宜。

liquid.en: Ole’s liquid clay involves manipulating soil – using and controlling it skilfully to achieve some result.
liquid.zh: 奥莱的液态粘土涉及对土壤的操纵——巧妙地使用和控制它以达到某种结果。

liquid.en: Prized for its taste and medicinal properties, in ancient times honey was known as 'liquid gold'.
liquid.zh: 蜂蜜因其口感和药用价值而备受珍视，在古代被称为“液体黄金”。

liquid.en: Mudslides tend to be faster and more liquid.
liquid.zh: 泥石流往往速度更快，且更具流动性。

liquid.en: And after that, came oil, which is an even more energy-dense fuel than coal, and being liquid, is far easier to transport.
liquid.zh: 在那之后，便是石油，它是一种能量密度比煤炭更高的燃料，而且由于是液体，运输起来要容易得多。

list.en: He grew the first mushrooms himself, then listed them for sale on his website.
list.zh: 他自己种植了第一批蘑菇，然后把它们挂在自己的网站上出售。

list.en: And even if they could, it would take them several hours to list them.
list.zh: 即便他们能，也得花上好几个小时才能列举完。

list.en: The teacher would be required to teach lists of word pairs to the learner.
list.zh: “教师”需要向“学生”教授一系列成对的单词。

list.en: But on the list of the others, Mind and Matter was one of them.
list.zh: 但在其他候选名单里，Mind and Matter是其中之一。

list.en: One thing that was missing from my list of accomplishments was getting my driving license.
list.zh: 我的成就清单上漏掉的一件事就是拿到驾照。

line.en: The line between reality and the roles they were playing had become dangerously blurred.
line.zh: 现实与他们所扮演角色之间的界限，已经模糊到了危险的地步。

line.en: Earthquake risk is another serious concern, as the city sits near major fault lines.
line.zh: 地震风险是另一个严重的问题，因为该市靠近主要断层线。

line.en: Perhaps he would even have declared something along the lines of “I am happy”.
line.zh: 也许他甚至会发出“我很幸福”之类的感慨。

line.en: But the critics' concern is not really about where the line is drawn today.
line.zh: 但批评者真正担心的，其实并不是今天这条界线划在哪里。

line.en: No trial. This was the “Wild” West, but even here, this crossed a line.
line.zh: 没有审判。这里是“狂野”的西部，但即便如此，这也已经越过了底线。

living.en: First, let's meet Roushanna Gray, a wild-food forager living in Cape Point, South Africa.
living.zh: 首先，让我们认识一下居住在南非开普角的野食采集者 Roushanna Gray。

living.en: The difference between living on two dollars a day and ten dollars is enormous.
living.zh: 靠每天两美元生活和靠十美元生活有着巨大的区别。

living.en: The majority were the elderly, who had outlived their ability to earn a living.
living.zh: 大多数是老年人，他们的寿命已经超出了他们谋生的能力。

living.en: They adapted to living with humans. They evolved to fit into our social world.
living.zh: 它们适应了与人类共同生活。它们进化得能够融入我们的社会世界。

living.en: It is a minimum across the world. It is not a comfortable standard of living.
living.zh: 它是全球的最低标准。它并非一个舒适的生活标准。

lip.en: I pull my mask past my lips and you study my face, Eyes wide.
lip.zh: 我把口罩拉过嘴唇，你端详着我的脸，双眼圆睁。

lip.en: And he just, he didn't even respond. He just took, he just like pursed his lips and nodded.
lip.zh: 他甚至没有回应。他只是抿了抿嘴，点了点头。

lifetime.en: Hard times last long, but an epic story feels like a lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 艰难的时光持续很久，但一段史诗般的故事感觉就像一生。

lifetime.en: Do you think it is something that we will see in your lifetime?
lifetime.zh: 你认为这是我们在有生之年能看到的事情吗？

lifetime.en: Previous and subsequent emperors became deified after death, but Caligula demanded worship in his own lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 前任和后来的皇帝都是在死后才被奉为神明，但 Caligula 要求在世时就受到崇拜。

lifetime.en: But they reported that 84% of people in Sierra Leone had paid someone a bribe in their lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 但他们报告说，塞拉利昂84%的人在一生中都向别人行过贿。

lifetime.en: It’s not just Sierra Leone either. There were lots of countries where over 50% of people had paid bribes in their lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 不仅仅是塞拉利昂。有许多国家的半数以上人口在一生中都行过贿。

literal.en: The Unabomber was extraordinary in the literal sense of the word.
literal.zh: The Unabomber 是字面意义上的不同寻常（extraordinary）。

literal.en: The word hyperbole comes from two ancient Greek words: huper andballo.But what is their literal meaning?
literal.zh: hyperbole 这个词来自两个古希腊单词：huper 和 ballo。但它们的字面意思是什么？

literal.en: An idiom is a phrase or expression whose meaning is different from the literal meaning of the words.
literal.zh: 习语是一个短语或表达，其含义与字面意思不同。

literal.en: Just to quickly summarize… An idiom is a phrase whose meaning isn’t literal, like “break the ice” or “spill the beans “.
literal.zh: 简单快速地总结一下……习语是一个字面意思与实际含义不同的短语，比如“break the ice”或“spill the beans”。

lime.en: And finally, guacamole is a paste made of mashed avocado, lime juice and salt – delicious!
lime.zh: 最后，guacamole 是一种由捣碎的牛油果、青柠汁和盐制成的酱——非常美味！

lime.en: They say, let's lime. And liming means spending time together with no purpose whatsoever.
lime.zh: 他们说，让我们去“lime”。而“liming”的意思就是毫无目的地消磨时间。

lime.en: They say, let's lime. And liming means spending time together with no purpose whatsoever.
lime.zh: 他们说，让我们去“lime”。而“liming”的意思就是毫无目的地消磨时间。

literature.en: We've all heard of geniuses who produce great works of literature or magnificent musical compositions.
literature.zh: 我们都听说过那些创作出伟大文学作品或壮丽音乐作品的天才。

literature.en: And one sounds like advice from an English teacher, which is to read good literature.
literature.zh: 其中一条听起来像是英语老师会给的建议，那就是：多读一些优秀的文学作品。

literature.en: Music, art, literature, and sports became central to Australia’s identity.
literature.zh: 音乐、艺术、文学和体育成为了澳大利亚身份认同的核心。

literature.en: These exams were usually based on Confucian philosophy and literature.
literature.zh: 这些考试通常以儒家哲学和文学为基础。

literature.en: Professor Karen Dillon is the author of a book on twins in American literature and a twin herself.
literature.zh: 凯伦·狄龙教授是一本关于美国文学中双胞胎的书的作者，她自己也是个双胞胎。

literally.en: They gave the area the name Rio de Janeiro, which literally means “January River.”
literally.zh: 他们给这个地区取名为里约热内卢，字面意思是“一月之河”。

literally.en: Well, yes but actually no, Georgie. I mean, Taylor Swift literally rocks the world!
literally.zh: 嗯，是的，但其实也不是，Georgie。我的意思是，Taylor Swift真的让世界摇滚了！

literally.en: Because I knew from the beginning. Literally, I write about this in the book.
literally.zh: 因为我从一开始就知道。字面上，我在书里写到了这一点。

literally.en: The name comes from Ancient Greek and literally means “the land between rivers “.
literally.zh: 这个名字源自古希腊语，字面意思是“两河之间的土地”。

literally.en: A pale, P-A-L-E, as a noun, is literally a fenced boundary, an enclosure.
literally.zh: “Pale”这个词作为名词，字面意思是栅栏边界或围场。

lighter.en: Perfumers in Grasse and Paris began refining their distillation techniques, using alcohol instead of oil to create lighter, more wearable fragrances.
lighter.zh: 格拉斯和巴黎的调香师开始改进他们的蒸馏技术，用酒精代替油来创造更轻盈、更易佩戴的香水。

lighter.en: And I promise you that when you clear away the stuff that has no purpose in your life, you will feel better, lighter, uplifted, energised!
lighter.zh: 我向你保证，当你清理掉生活中毫无用处的东西时，你会感觉更好、更轻松、振奋、充满活力！

lighter.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
lighter.zh: 美国的监管机构已开始将核聚变视为与传统核能完全不同的类别，并适用更宽松的规则，因为核聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生熔毁。

lining.en: The expression silver lining means a positive thing that comes from a negative situation.
lining.zh: silver lining 这个说法，指的是从一个不好的情况中产生出的积极结果。

lining.en: A silver lining is a positive thing that comes from a negative situation.
lining.zh: silver lining 指的是从不好的情况中产生出的积极结果。

lining.en: But then, you know, the silver lining of that terrible period for many people was that they got to like, just like pause for a moment.
lining.zh: 但后来，你知道，那个对许多人来说可怕时期的亮点是他们能够，只是像暂停一下。

lining.en: One account has him marching his troops northwards, as if to attack Great Britain, but after lining his troops up on the beach in Gaul, he orders them to collect seashells instead of continue their mission, declaring these the “spoils of the ocean”.
lining.zh: 有一个记载说，他率领军队向北行进，仿佛要进攻英国，但在高卢的海滩上排好军队后，他却命令他们去收集贝壳而不是继续任务，并宣称这些是“海洋的战利品”。

lion.en: It was actually lions – how scary! OK. It's time to recap the vocabulary we've learned.
lion.zh: 其实是狮子——多吓人啊！好了。是时候回顾我们学过的词汇了。

lion.en: His advisors identified the animal as a lion, and the prince decided to establish a settlement there.
lion.zh: 他的顾问将这只动物认作狮子，于是王子决定在那里建立一个定居点。

lion.en: Lion City. There is a big problem with this story, though.
lion.zh: 狮城。然而，这个故事有一个很大的问题。

lion.en: Or the marsupial lion, a ferocious predator and hunter.
lion.zh: 还有有袋狮，这是一种凶猛的掠食者和猎手。

lion.en: Was it a) elephants, b) lions, or c) zebras?
lion.zh: 是 a) 大象，b) 狮子，还是 c) 斑马？

linguistic.en: Ethnicity means the social, cultural and linguistic characteristics shared by a group of people.
linguistic.zh: “族群”（Ethnicity）意味着一群人所共享的社会、文化和语言特征。

linguistic.en: And in part three, we’ll talk about the fantastic linguistic and cultural concept of enshittification.
linguistic.zh: 而在第三部分，我们会聊聊“enshittification”这个精彩的语言与文化概念。

linguistic.en: Are there any linguistic influences from the world of mercenaries that have entered your language?
linguistic.zh: 有没有什么来自雇佣兵世界的语言影响已经进入了你的语言？
在印地语中，“kal”这个词既可以指“昨天”，也可以指“明天”。

literary.en: John Payne Collier was one of the most prolific literary forgers in English history.
literary.zh: John Payne Collier 是英国历史上最多产的文学造假者之一。

literary.en: If we mean the first great literary work, then maybe the Epic of Gilgamesh.
literary.zh: 如果我们指的是第一部伟大的文学作品，那也许是《Epic of Gilgamesh》。

literary.en: If we want to think about the earliest literary works, historians usually point to a few different places.
literary.zh: 如果我们想考虑最早的文学作品，历史学家通常会指向几个不同的地方。

literary.en: His father was something of a free spirit—an adventurer, a friend to literary figures, and a bit of a gambler.
literary.zh: 他的父亲有点像个自由灵魂——一个冒险家、文学界名流的朋友，还带点赌徒气质。

literary.en: OK, I don't know exactly what this says about Australia, but when you win this big literary prize they have there, the Melbourne Prize for Literature, you're required to spend half the money, half of it, to get out of Melbourne and travel abroad.
literary.zh: 好吧，我不知道这到底说明了澳大利亚的什么状况，但当你赢得当地这个极具分量的文学奖——墨尔本文学奖时，你必须花掉奖金的一半，整整一半，离开墨尔本去国外旅行。

lightning.en: We stopped waiting for the lightning, and learned how to make fire ourselves.
lightning.zh: 我们不再等待闪电，而是学会了自己生火。

lightning.en: Petersburg. And once in the capital, his career took off at lightning speed.
lightning.zh: 一旦来到首都，他的职业生涯便以闪电般的速度腾飞。

lightning.en: Their armies swept through eastern Zaire with lightning speed, facing little resistance.
lightning.zh: 他们的军队以闪电般的速度横扫扎伊尔东部，几乎没有遇到什么抵抗。

lightning.en: Lightning strikes a dry tree. A lava flow ignites grassland.
lightning.zh: 闪电击中干燥的树木。熔岩流点燃了草原。

lightning.en: And-- It's like you're waiting for the lightning bolt.
lightning.zh: 而且——就好像你在等待闪电劈下来一样。

lightly.en: You wake up frequently, you sleep lightly and uncomfortably.
lightly.zh: 你频繁醒来，睡眠很浅而且很不舒服。

limb.en: I'm going to go out on a limb and say that I imagine you might not know all that much about the Comoros Islands.
limb.zh: 我冒昧猜想一下，你可能对科摩罗群岛并不怎么了解。

liberal.en: You might have heard of the Liberal Democrats, the Scottish National Party, the Green party, or even UKIP.
liberal.zh: 你可能听说过自由民主党、苏格兰民族党、绿党，甚至英国独立党。

liberal.en: The Liberal Democrats have done quite well in recent elections.
liberal.zh: 自由民主党在最近的选举中表现相当不错。

liberal.en: Together, these seven subjects made up the so-called “liberal arts,” which were the foundation of medieval higher education.
liberal.zh: 这七门学科共同构成了所谓的“自由艺术”，它们是中世纪高等教育的基础。

liberal.en: Singapore’s political system is often described as somewhere in the middle of a liberal Western democracy and an authoritarian state.
liberal.zh: 新加坡的政治体制通常被描述为介于自由西方民主国家和威权国家之间。

liberal.en: It was like liberal people who are, you know, and some of the things they were saying to me in emails or like online.
liberal.zh: 他们就像是自由派的人，你知道，他们通过电子邮件或在线对我说的一些话。

litter.en: It went like this: a brave human hunter found a litter of wolf cubs, took one home, and raised it.
litter.zh: 它是这样的：一个勇敢的人类猎人发现了一窝狼崽，带回一只并抚养长大。

lively.en: And it’s this reliance on maintaining confidence that makes British politics so lively, for want of a better word.
lively.zh: 正是这种对维持信任的依赖，使得英国政治如此生动，如果换个更好的词的话。

liberate.en: Mainly, it's that I see or hear people's freedom, and then that liberates me further.
liberate.zh: 主要是因为我看到或听到了人们的自由，这进一步解放了我。

liberate.en: Technology, he argued, did not liberate us; it enslaved us.
liberate.zh: 他辩称，技术并没有解放我们；而是奴役了我们。

liberate.en: That's right. Preferably all three. it's very liberating.
liberate.zh: 没错。最好三个都选。这非常令人解脱。

liberate.en: It's fascinating, frustrating, and liberating at the same time.
liberate.zh: 这既迷人、令人沮丧，又令人解放。

lieutenant.en: One such officer was Claus von Stauffenberg, a 36-year-old Lieutenant Colonel who had been awarded the Iron Cross for his bravery in the Battle of France.
lieutenant.zh: 其中一位军官是克劳斯·冯·施陶芬贝格（Claus von Stauffenberg），他是一名36岁的中校，曾在法兰西战役中因英勇表现而被授予铁十字勋章。

lieutenant.en: The focus quickly switched to a threat from within, and suspicion fell on the man who had entered with a briefcase, then quickly left without one: Lieutenant Colonel von Stauffenberg.
lieutenant.zh: 焦点迅速转移到来自内部的威胁，怀疑落在了那个提着公文包进来、随后又空手迅速离开的人身上：中校冯·施陶芬贝格。

limitation.en: People have different natural abilities, circumstances, opportunities, limitations.
limitation.zh: 人们拥有不同的天赋、环境、机遇和局限性。

limitation.en: Of course, people have different abilities, different limitations.
limitation.zh: 当然，人与人能力不同，局限性也不同。

limitation.en: But measuring poverty has serious limitations.
limitation.zh: 但衡量贫困有着严重的局限性。

limitation.en: Now, surveys like this are neat, but they have a big limitation: they rely on people remembering and summarising their happiness.
limitation.zh: 这类调查虽然很整洁，但它们有一个很大的局限性：它们依赖于人们对幸福的记忆和总结。

limitation.en: But to truly understand the effects and the powers and the abilities and limitations and the advantages and disadvantages of wealth, you have to use your neocortex a lot more.
limitation.zh: 但要真正理解财富的影响、力量、能力、局限性以及优势和劣势，你必须更多地动用你的新皮层。

linger.en: So I'll bet that lingers. And then, as I said, money solves your money problem.
linger.zh: 所以我敢打赌这种感觉会挥之不去。而且，正如我所说，金钱能解决你的金钱问题。

linger.en: Sweat, unwashed clothes, the lingering scent of livestock or open sewage in the streets, it was all unavoidable, the world was just smellier.
linger.zh: 汗水、没洗过的衣服、挥之不去的牲畜气味或街上露天下水道的味道，这些都是不可避免的，世界就是这么臭。

linger.en: For years, Mubarak had banned it outright, jailing its leaders and branding it a threat, yet letting it linger in the background as something of a bogeyman.
linger.zh: 多年来，Mubarak 一直彻底禁止它，将其领导人投入监狱并将其打上威胁的烙印，但又让它作为某种替罪羊在后台苟延残喘。

linger.en: He was 64 years old. And yet, more than two thousand years later, the fear he inspired, the brilliance he displayed, the legacy he left behind… it still lingers.
linger.zh: 他享年64岁。然而，两千多年过去了，他激发出的恐惧、他展现出的才华、他留下的传奇……依然历久弥新，萦绕不散。

linger.en: But suspicions have lingered that the bombings were not the work of Chechen terrorists but a false flag operation orchestrated by Russia’s own security services to justify the war and bolster Putin’s image as a strong leader.
linger.zh: 然而，外界一直怀疑这些爆炸案并非车臣恐怖分子所为，而是由俄罗斯自身安全部门精心策划的“假旗行动”，旨在为战争制造借口并树立普京作为强力领袖的形象。

liberation.en: Lawrence, the supposed flag carrier and chief proponent of an Arab liberation movement.
liberation.zh: Lawrence，这位所谓的阿拉伯解放运动的旗手和主要支持者。

linen.en: And then there are the synthetic ingredients, which allow perfumers to create scents that don’t exist in nature, like the smell of fresh linen or a salty ocean breeze.
linen.zh: 还有合成成分，它们使调香师能够创造出自然界中不存在的气味，比如新鲜亚麻布的气味或咸咸的海风。

literacy.en: One thing I think is really important is improving media literacy and critical thinking.
literacy.zh: 我认为真正重要的一件事是提高媒体素养和批判性思维。

literacy.en: Critical thinking and media literacy is now essential.
literacy.zh: 批判性思维和媒体素养现在至关重要。

literacy.en: Literacy rates gradually increased as well.
literacy.zh: 识字率也随之逐渐提高。

literacy.en: The towns there were relatively dense, and the education levels, the literacy rates, were a bit higher than other parts of British North America.
literacy.zh: 那里的城镇相对密集，教育水平和识字率比英属北美的其他地区要高一些。

literacy.en: Mustafa Kemal wanted literacy rates to rise, and he believed that by simplifying the language, more people would be able to read and write.
literacy.zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔希望提高识字率，他相信通过简化语言，更多的人将能够识字。

liability.en: Second, the unpredictable and self-serving nature of the condottieri made them a liability.
liability.zh: 其次，condottieri 不可预测且唯利是图的性质使他们成了一个包袱。

liability.en: He was also an awful drunk and was seen as a liability.
liability.zh: 他也是个臭名昭著的酒鬼，被视为一种累赘。

liver.en: I think we just don't know it's supplements outside of the international context, like just eat liver, man.
liver.zh: 我觉得在国际背景之外，我们根本不知道补剂的作用，还是吃点肝脏吧，伙计。

liver.en: The example I can think of right now is, I always remember observing an American English teacher’s class where during a pronunciation lesson focusing on L-R minimal pairs, /l/, /r/ minimal pairs… river versus liver.
liver.zh: 我现在能想到的例子是，我一直记得曾经观摩过一位美籍英语老师的课，当时是在上一堂专注于 L-R 最小对立体、/l/、/r/ 最小对立体的发音课……river（河流）与 liver（肝脏）。

linear.en: For the majority of you listening, you are likely most familiar with “linear time”.
linear.zh: 这就是时间沿直线流逝的观点。

linear.en: You become worse at the language. There are many reasons why progress would not be linear.
linear.zh: 你的语言变差了。进步不是线性的原因有很多。

linear.en: The first thing is that I assumed my progress would be linear.
linear.zh: 第一件事是，我曾以为我的进步会是线性的。

linear.en: People in a linear culture might answer July and August (if you’re in the Northern Hemisphere).
linear.zh: 我们说七月和八月，因为日程表上就是这么定的。

linear.en: But I never had something that was linear, close to linear.
linear.zh: 但我从未有过一件线性的、接近线性的事情。

liberty.en: They have rights just for being human. These rights include life, liberty, and property.
liberty.zh: 他们仅仅因为是人类就拥有权利。这些权利包括生命、自由和财产。

liberty.en: Slavery was legal, for example, despite all of that talk in the Constitution and the Declaration of Independence about liberty and equality.
liberty.zh: 例如，奴隶制是合法的，尽管宪法和独立宣言中有那么多关于自由和平等的言论。

license.en: One thing that was missing from my list of accomplishments was getting my driving license.
license.zh: 我的成就清单上漏掉的一件事就是拿到驾照。

license.en: And that's what switched me into the licensing model.
license.zh: 正是这个转变让我走向了授权经营的模式。

license.en: I had to pass a 50 question test for my provisional license, and then a 90 question test for my final exam.
license.zh: 我必须通过一个50道题的临时驾照测试，然后是最终考试的90道题测试。

license.en: Because everything was unregulated.'The way that you know that Strive Masiyiwa and Iqbal Quadir were first, was that they didn't pay for the licenses.
license.zh: 因为那边什么都没有监管。”而你能知道斯特赖夫·马西尤瓦和伊克巴尔·夸德尔确实是第一批入局者的一个方式，就是他们当初根本没为牌照付过钱。

license.en: Within years--within just a few years--the licenses spectrum for mobile telephony, even in poor countries, was going in the tens and hundreds of millions of dollars.
license.zh: 而就在几年之内——短短几年之内——移动通信的频谱牌照，即便是在贫穷国家，价格也已经飙升到了数千万乃至数亿美元。

liar.en: No income no asset loans, that's a liar's loan.
liar.zh: 无收入无资产贷款，那就是骗子贷款。

liar.en: So even though there might be a few liars in the system, as long as there aren't too many liars and too many cheaters, a high trust society where everybody's honest is better off.
liar.zh: 所以即使系统中可能会有几个骗子，只要骗子和作瑟没有那么多，一个每个人都诚实的高信任社会就会过得更好。

liar.en: So even though there might be a few liars in the system, as long as there aren't too many liars and too many cheaters, a high trust society where everybody's honest is better off.
liar.zh: 所以即使系统中可能会有几个骗子，只要骗子和作瑟没有那么多，一个每个人都诚实的高信任社会就会过得更好。

liquor.en: He says, was it leverage liquor in women?
liquor.zh: 他说，是杠杆、酒和女人吗？

lick.en: I remember being a little bit critical of guys in the early part who would lick their plates.
lick.zh: 我还记得早期对那些舔盘子的家伙有点评头论足。
